fields.name: network
fields.description: This is the IPv4 network in CIDR format such as 2.21.92.0/29.

fields.name: geoname_id
fields.description: A unique identifier for the network's location as specified by GeoNames. It is the id of the country, or of a continent when MaxMind gives no country. Where MaxMind has no location for the network, the registered country is used; if there is none either, it is empty.

fields.name: continent_code
fields.description: The continent code for this IP: AF - Africa, AN - Antarctica, AS - Asia, EU - Europe, NA - North America, OC - Oceania, SA - South America. Empty when the network has no location. NA is the code for North America, not a missing value.

fields.name: continent_name
fields.description: The continent name for this location

fields.name: country_iso_code
fields.description: A two-character ISO 3166-1 country code for the country associated with the location. Empty when the location is only a continent or unknown. NA is the code for Namibia, not a missing value.

fields.name: country_name
fields.description: The country name for this location. Empty when the location is only a continent or unknown.

fields.name: is_anonymous_proxy
fields.description: MaxMind's flag for an anonymous proxy: 1 or 0. In the data we checked every row is 0, so do not use it to detect proxies.

fields.name: is_satellite_provider
fields.description: MaxMind's flag for a satellite provider that serves several countries: 1 or 0. In the data we checked every row is 0.
